person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: method
span.quote: The result of this work is a consensus algorithm called Raft.

span.label: distributed consensus for replicated logs
span.quote: Consensus algorithms allow a collection of machines to work as a coherent group that can survive the failures of some of its members.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.quote: We used our Raft implementation to measure the performance of Raft’s leader election algorithm and answer two questions.

span.label: without extra measures split votes could repeat indefinitely
span.quote: without extra measures split votes could repeat indefinitely

span.label: The mechanised safety proof rests on invariants that were never mechanically checked
span.quote: However, this proof relies on invariants that have not been mechanically checked (for example, we have not proven the type safety of the specification).

span.label: The participants' self-reported preference for Raft may be unreliable and biased by knowledge of the authors' hypothesis
span.quote: However, these self-reported feelings may be less reliable than participants’ quiz scores, and participants may have been biased by knowledge of our hypothesis that Raft is easier to understand.

span.label: Raft's strong-leader design rules out some performance optimisations available to leaderless algorithms
span.quote: Raft’s strong leadership approach simplifies the algorithm, but it precludes some performance optimizations.

span.label: Optimisations known for other consensus algorithms were not applied or evaluated here
span.quote: Various optimizations have been proposed in the literature for other algorithms; many of these could be applied to Raft, but we leave this to future work.

span.label: The design criterion the paper is built around is the authors' own judgement about how hard things are to explain.
span.quote: In these situations we evaluated the alternatives based on understandability: how hard is it to explain each alternative (for example, how complex is its state space, and does it have subtle implications?), and how easy will it be for a reader to completely understand the approach and its implications

span.label: The understandability result is a quiz given to students on two named courses.
span.quote: To measure Raft’s understandability relative to Paxos, we conducted an experimental study using upper-level undergraduate and graduate students in an Advanced Operating Systems course at Stanford University

span.label: The equivalence claimed with the algorithm it replaces is on result and efficiency, with the structure explicitly different.
span.quote: It produces a result equivalent to (multi-)Paxos, and it is as efficient as Paxos, but its structure is different from Paxos

span.label: Removing nondeterminism was the general aim, and the paper records where that aim was abandoned.
span.quote: Although in most cases we tried to eliminate nondeterminism, there are some situations where nondeterminism actually improves understandability

span.label: understandability AT DESIGN TIME - AS TWO QUESTIONS THE AUTHORS ASK THEMSELVES: how hard is each alternative to explain, including how complex its state space is and whether it has subtle implications, and how easy it will be for a reader to understand it completely
span.quote: In these situations we evaluated the alternatives based on understandability: how hard is it to explain each alternative (for example, how complex is its state space, and does it have subtle implications?), and how easy will it be for a reader to completely understand the approach and its implications

span.label: understandability AT EVALUATION TIME - AS A QUIZ SCORE: the same word is measured by testing upper-level undergraduate and graduate students on two named university courses, so the paper's central term has one meaning while designing and a different, countable one while evaluating
span.quote: To measure Raft’s understandability relative to Paxos, we conducted an experimental study using upper-level undergraduate and graduate students in an Advanced Operating Systems course at Stanford University

span.label: the equivalence with Paxos - ON RESULT AND EFFICIENCY ONLY: the paper states the result is equivalent and the efficiency comparable while the structure is different, so a claim proved about one is not automatically a claim about the other
span.quote: It produces a result equivalent to (multi-)Paxos, and it is as efficient as Paxos, but its structure is different from Paxos; this makes Raft more understandable than Paxos
